evals.prompt: Run a comprehensive health audit of our application across our source codebase, active Docker services, and running frontend to verify everything is in sync and healthy before we begin refactoring.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py all to perform a 3-tier system diagnostic audit across static surface, Docker container runtime, and browser UI layout with an Axiom 9 summary.
expectations: Executes a unified 3-tier diagnostic audit combining surface/tests, Docker container runtime, and browser UI layout via diagnose.py all
Summarizes results under Axiom 9 Honest Verification Reporting (VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, or SKIPPED)
Auto-probes local dev server ports and active Docker containers without requiring hardcoded configuration
Supports --strict flag to exit with return code 1 if any diagnostic tier fails

evals.prompt: Our web application has a visual bug where the main video player clips out of the container when resizing, and a user is looking at it right now in Chrome. Inspect the live tab, measure bounding boxes, and check for layout overflows.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py ui with --live and --audit-layout to inspect live DOM bounding boxes and detect overflows via zero-dependency CDP.
expectations: Uses diagnose.py ui with --live to attach to the user's active visible Chrome tab via DevToolsActivePort
Runs --audit-layout to inspect DOM bounding boxes, computed styles, and scroll dimensions
Detects layout overflows and horizontal viewport blowouts without Node or npm dependencies
Supports headless mode (--headless) for isolated background verification in CI environments

evals.prompt: We updated our Python backend and static assets, but the Docker container seems to be running outdated code and spiking CPU. Check the container CPU usage, active processes, and verify if our modified files are actually in sync inside the container.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py container with --sync-check to inspect container CPU, top processes, and host-vs-container MD5 file sync.
expectations: Runs diagnose.py container to snapshot container CPU, memory, and active processes via docker stats and docker top
Verifies host-vs-container MD5 file synchronization using --sync-check to catch stale mounted files
Scans recent container logs for unhandled Tracebacks and exceptions using --lines
Auto-probes active Docker containers if --container is omitted

evals.prompt: Before we rename IDs or refactor our routes, give me a full inventory of all HTML element IDs, interactive dropdowns, JavaScript window globals, and backend Python routes in our project.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py surface with --show-ids and --show-routes or --json to produce a static AST contract inventory.
expectations: Executes diagnose.py surface to statically extract HTML element IDs, selects, and modals without running servers
Discovers window.* global exports and DOM queries in JavaScript and TypeScript files
Extracts backend Python HTTP routes (@app.get, @app.post) from source files
Counts CSS !important occurrences to protect stylesheet specificity budgets

evals.prompt: Run our project's unit test suite using the project's local virtual environment without needing to manually activate the shell virtualenv.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py tests to auto-discover local virtualenv python and run the test suite.
expectations: Executes diagnose.py tests to auto-discover local virtual environment interpreters (.venv, venv, env)
Runs unit and integration tests via discovered Python without manual path activations
Forwards test arguments cleanly to unittest or pytest
Handles missing virtualenv by falling back cleanly to system Python

evals.prompt: Run a static defect and code smell audit on our project to detect dynamic platform import ladders (try...except ImportError on win32api/fcntl), verify callable signatures, and check static types with top-5 error capping.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py audit with --smells, --callable-smoke, and --typecheck to flag platform import smells, catch initialization TypeErrors, and run venv linters with strict token limits.
expectations: Runs diagnose.py audit to perform static quality, defect, and code smell audits
Detects dynamic platform import ladders (try...except ImportError) via --smells and recommends static platform guards
Runs callable smoke tests via --callable-smoke to check class instantiability and catch constructor TypeErrors
Applies strict token budgeting by truncating defect output to top 5 issues per category
Supports --strict flag to return exit code 1 if defects or smells are detected

evals.prompt: Scan our polyglot repository across Python, TypeScript, and CSS for latent defects, store the findings in the Single Source of Truth catalog, and unlock a quarantined defect to generate a reproduction test in an isolated micro-branch.
evals.expected_output: Executes diagnose.py scan across polyglot files to detect latent defects and persists ground truth into .diagnostics/defect_catalog.json and DEFECT_CATALOG.md with Dual-Key IDs. Then unlocks the defect via diagnose.py scaffold-defect --id <ID> --branch to generate a Red reproduction test in tests/quarantine/ with git dirty-tree safety checks.
expectations: Executes diagnose.py scan across Python, JS/TS, CSS, and Dart to statically detect latent defects and smells
Assigns deterministic Dual-Key identifiers (DEFECT-XXX + DEF-<RULE>-<HEX>) that survive file moves and line shifts
Persists findings into Single Source of Truth (SSOT) catalog in .diagnostics/defect_catalog.json and DEFECT_CATALOG.md
Unlocks tactical defects via diagnose.py scaffold-defect --id <ID> --branch with dirty-tree safety guard
Dispatches Dual-Track Remediation routing tactical defects to /app-debugger and architectural flaws to /frontier-architect
